summary: In this excerpt from Book 10, the narrator recounts a day spent in bed and on the sofa after an upsetting job experience, sick from vomiting and ignoring messages and visitors. Rhindquist, apparently the CEO of the Company, shows up, hugs the narrator, and spends the night watching comedies with him. At breakfast Rhindquist explains that he chose the narrator because he thought him naive enough to enjoy the job, and admits he was wrong, which does not comfort the narrator.
one_line: A distraught narrator spends a day hiding from work until CEO Rhindquist visits, watches comedies with him, and explains why he chose him.
key_facts: The narrator spent all last night throwing up and was unsure whether to go to the office that day.
The narrator did not go to work the previous day and instead sat on the sofa in shorts watching movies.
The narrator's watch got loud and angry, so the narrator stuck it underneath a pillow.
The narrator ignored messages that started appearing on the TV.
The narrator fell asleep after the film Wall Street and woke after 18h to someone pounding on the door.
Rhindquist arrived looking sad and beaten and gave the narrator a hug.
Rhindquist put on the movie Blazing Saddles, then The Princess Bride, and they watched movies all night.
When the narrator woke in bed, Rhindquist had put a blanket over him and was asleep on the sofa.
Rhindquist's phone was on the TV with its batteries on the floor.
The narrator ate three bowls of cereal, some toast and an apple for breakfast.
Rhindquist drank a GatorCola from the narrator's fridge and burped.
Rhindquist described Rhindquist's CEO role as running the whole Company, and the narrator found him seeming like an ordinary person while drinking a Goke.
Rhindquist said, "You've been in my shoes now. Wouldn't you do anything to get out of them?"
Rhindquist said he thought the narrator was ignorant enough to enjoy the job, then admitted "I was wrong. You're too smart."
The narrator went back to the sofa and put on the movie Horsefeathers, which Rhindquist watched with him.
